title: Survey Dutch Municipal Council Members 2012-2013
descriptions: Representative survey among local representatives in The Netherlands using a battery of DPES (Nederlands Kiezersonderzoek, NKO) questions. N=796. Data collected November 2012-January 2013, using online survey tool, as part of research conducted at the University of Amsterdam.
Dataset and questionnaire in Dutch. Dataset description in English.The .dta file is supplied by the depositor. DANS added the .sav and .por file.
description: Representative survey among local representatives in The Netherlands using a battery of DPES (Nederlands Kiezersonderzoek, NKO) questions. N=796. Data collected November 2012-January 2013, using online survey tool, as part of research conducted at the University of Amsterdam.

relations.text: References: Van Ditmars, M.M. (2013) Party representation in local Dutch politics. Universiteit van Amsterdam

data_sources:
The questions from the survey stem from the Dutch Parliamentary Election Study 2010 (NKO 2010), http://dx.doi.org/10.17026/dans-xvh-tghy

The dataset description, including sampling strategy, stems from the following publication: Van Ditmars, M.M. (2013) Party representation in local Dutch politics. Universiteit van Amsterdam. (accessible through http://dare.uva.nl/en/scriptie/451391)
